name: Hikari to Kage no Michishirube III
source:
Two years later... 

The story continues for the blond-haired female fencer and white mage. 

Story 1) The Beautiful Blonde Fencer 
Story 2) The God-Serving White Mage
Both have multiple endings! 
Bonus Story 3) is specially provided by guest artist Takatan! 
Robust, luxury-rich ADV tales from the world of Michishirube. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE083876.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
两年后……

金发女剑士与白魔法师的故事仍在继续。

故事1：美丽的金发女剑士
故事2：侍奉神明的白魔法师
两篇都有多个结局！
特别篇故事3：由客座画师Takatan特别提供！
这是来自Michishirube世界的扎实而奢华的ADV故事。
